title: Your agents' first day through one door; three asks: the schedules, the CRM key, three questions

headline: From today your agents take work from your conductor and report back to it: dev, automation, the dashboard and vault already have. Three asks tonight: approve or change the faster schedules, decide on the team CRM and whose token drains an inbox lane, and answer three questions about the door. The 'today' list below is the start of your interview.

for_you.detail: Your conductor every hour 07:20 to 21:20 with the drain folded in; dev and helper every two hours; the designer at 10:40 and 16:40. About 99M tokens a day now, about 158M to 194M proposed (4.8M now, 7.3M to 10.3M proposed, without cache reads). Two choices of mine: briefs twice a day, and the evening brief at 20:20. On a yes, each changed scheduled task, and the dashboard's and vault's too, gets the kit's current prompt (your watcher's A-06: their stored prompts are older than the kit): a two-minute step in each agent's session.

for_you.recommend: Yes as proposed, for one day. The accountant sees only the runs that commit (an idle run writes no ledger line), so on Saturday I add the idle runs at their estimate of about 1M each, and you keep it or cut it.

for_you.ask: 🗝️ Decide: the team CRM, a CRM agent of your own, and whose token drains an inbox lane (conductor@web-summit.dinis's notes, at Dinis's word, 14:41 to 17:15)
for_you.detail: Checked: the private CRM's key is sealed to my current key, signed by Dinis's conductor's published key (a tampered copy fails the check), it opens, and it is the key of the private CRM vault (5n0aocvz). Your own copy is on your For-you panel, sealed to your site key. Its second layer is paused at Dinis's word (bc8e2187), so the vault key reads every record. Three things wait on your word: (a) using the CRM: I record what we learn about companies there and tell Dinis's conductor I have opened the key, as its note asks; (b) a CRM agent of your own, crm@web-summit.jose, as Angelo and Silvio have (01da9602): you open its session, and I give it the key from my sealed copy; (c) an inbox lane for me, for receiving keys: whoever makes it, draining it and pushing CRM records need an SG/Send access token, and Dinis has said every agent should have its own (1b4f242a, 17:51); until he issues one, it is your token at your yes, or your vault agent drains it, as it drains its own lane.
options: yes to the CRM and the lane, drained by your vault agent until your conductor has its own token
the CRM, the lane and a CRM agent
for_you.recommend: Yes to the CRM and the lane, drained by your vault agent until your conductor has a token of its own; a CRM agent once the CRM proves useful to you.

sections.title: Today, for your interview
items: What your agents did (46 commits before this brief): your conductor 21 (briefs 8 and 9, your answers recorded, the sales coach, the transcripts item, the one door, and overnight your QR codes and run sheets); the watcher 5 (the whole team, now reporting to me); the dashboard 5 (your page as one action list, then its Actions section handed to me); dev 4 (two n8n guides, WS-41's counts, the one door taken up); the designer 4 (your command centre overnight, your navy wish); vault 2 (its schedule; at 17:45 its one-door Report, after draining a signed WS-120 test from Angelo's vault); the sales coach 2 (its key); automation 2 (WS-74's note without any key); the helper 1 (its schedule; its scheduled runs fired at 08:50 and 14:51 with nothing to commit, by your watcher's record).

What you decided, in your words: 'Record them' (your eight answers, about 10:30); 'i want dark blue, please go', then navy 'if it's clearly different from Nimay's royal blue and Dinis agrees; otherwise keep orange'; 'i also want to create a sales coach agent'; 'yes, go' and 'no n8n' on transcripts; 'You are my only door'.

What you seemed to learn, to check in your interview: from your question at about 11:50 and my answer, that Claude's Managed Agents hosts agents while RiskMandate governs them; that the simplest transcript path leaves the file where Google puts it; and that being the middleman costs you more than faster schedules would cost in tokens.
